name: workflow-loom
title: WorkflowLoom
description: Arazzo workflow as a loom: lanes per source, step nodes, data threads, parallel branches (dependsOn), end and retry actions, and an equivalent Steps table.

a11y.pattern: role=group with toggle-button nodes (aria-pressed), roving tabindex, and a Show as table view
keyboard: Moves to the Show as table button, the diagram region, then to the loom (one tab stop for all steps)
Moves to the previous or next column
Moves to the previous or next lane or parallel branch in the same column
aria: The SVG is aria-hidden; every node is a button named "Step 3, patchPastry, PATCH /pastries/{name}, Failed after 3 attempts, Success criteria passed, Schema validation failed"
Actions (end, retry) and the AsyncAPI "not runnable" note are in the node's aria-describedby
Status is words plus a glyph: Passed, Failed, Not run (dashed outline, never reduced opacity)
Show as table (aria-pressed) swaps the diagram for a real table: #, Step, Source, Operation, Depends on, Status, Checks, Actions
The scrollable diagram and table are focusable regions with a name
a11y.notes: Copy the element bundle with the wrapper (elements/workflow-loom.js is self-contained). Angular: add schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA] to the host component. No goto: Arazzo actions are limited to end and retry in the Microcks POC. The loom reads the tokens (proto-*, link, border-control, success, danger), so load tokens.css.
